title: Add provider fallback configuration
description: Allow users to configure primary + fallback providers. Auto-switch on failures. Example: Primary=Voyage-3, Fallback=OpenAI, Tertiary=Local Jina.

title: Build per-set chunking configuration UI
description: Allow different chunking strategies per embedding set. Add chunking config to set creation/edit modal: strategy (recursive/sentence/token), chunk size, overlap, separators. Store in EmbeddingSet metadata. Apply when importing files to that set.

title: Build enhanced embedding settings UI with progressive disclosure
description: Redesign embedding-settings-section.tsx: Basic tab (provider/model/presets), Advanced tab (dimensions slider, batch size, overlap %), Expert tab (late chunking, quantization). Replace current toggle-only UI.

title: Add late chunking support for long documents
description: Implement late chunking for Jina v3 and Voyage Context-3 models. Process full document context, then chunk embeddings. +5-15% retrieval improvement.

title: Implement model configuration presets
description: Add 3 configuration presets in UI: High Accuracy (Voyage-3), Cost Optimized (text-embedding-3-small), Multilingual (Cohere). Improves onboarding and reduces configuration complexity.

title: Implement embedding quality monitoring dashboard
description: Track metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rates, cache hit rates, cost per provider, daily volume. Display in settings panel with charts.

title: Implement batch optimization configuration
description: Add batch size controls (8-512), concurrency limits (1-20), timeout settings. Store in embedding preferences. Apply in embedding worker and factory.

title: Epic: Modernize Embedding Model Configuration & UX
description: Transform embedding model settings from basic toggles to production-ready configuration system with hosted provider support, modern 2025 models, comprehensive UI/UX, flexible dimensions, API key management, chunking strategies, and monitoring

title: Add embedding set selector to search interface
description: Add dropdown/selector showing all embedding sets with metadata (name, item count, model, dimensions). Let users switch which 'repo' they're searching. Show active set prominently in UI. Store selection in vectorStatusUIStore.

title: Implement configurable chunking strategies
description: Implement configurable chunking strategies. NOTE: Now superseded by per-set chunking (brainstrike-1852). This task now focuses on global chunking defaults in settings panel, not per-set config. Add UI controls for global defaults: chunk size, overlap %, strategy type. Store in preferences.

title: Remove 768D hard dimension constraint
description: Replace STANDARD_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION enforcement with dynamic dimension support. Update DB schema validation, factory validation, and UI badges to support 256-1536 dimensions. Critical - blocks testing non-768D models.

title: Associate file imports with specific embedding sets
description: Let users choose target embedding set when importing files. Update file-chunk repository to filter by embedding_set_id. Show which set each file belongs to in Files view. Support moving files between sets (re-embed).

title: Enhance chunking UI with LangChain splitter configuration
description: Expose LangChain text splitter options in UI: separators customization, keep_separator toggle, length_function selection. Add preview showing how sample text would be chunked with current settings. Improve discoverability of chunking strategies.

title: Implement embedding drift detection
description: Monitor embedding quality drift using cosine similarity + model-based detection. Alert when drift >15% from baseline. Re-benchmark quarterly.

title: Add test configuration button with latency/cost display
description: Test button sends sample text to backend, measures latency, calculates cost estimate. Shows results in success toast with metrics. Validates API keys work before saving.

title: Add embedding provider API key management UI
description: Extend LLM keys settings to support embedding providers (OpenAI, Google, Cohere, Voyage). Reuse existing secrets IPC infrastructure. Critical blocker - without API keys, hosted providers can't be tested.

title: Add model information panels with benchmarks
description: Display metadata for each model: MTEB scores, context window, supported dimensions, cost per 1M tokens, latency estimates. Help users make informed choices.

title: Extend EmbeddingSet model with user-facing metadata
description: Add name (user-provided), description, tags, category fields to EmbeddingSet model and DB schema. Update repository methods. Migrate existing auto-created sets with default names based on modelKey.

title: Update model registry with 2025 models
description: Add modern models to model-registry.json: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small/large, Jina v3, Voyage-3/3-lite, Cohere embed-v3. Include accurate dimensions, context windows, and metadata.

title: Design and implement embedding set management UI
description: Create UI for users to explicitly create, name, and manage embedding sets (vector repos). Include: create set modal (name, description, model selection), set list/grid view, active set selector, rename/delete operations. Sets become first-class user-facing entities.

title: Add semantic caching layer for embeddings
description: Implement Redis-based semantic cache: check cosine similarity >0.95 to return cached embeddings. Can save 50-90% of API costs for repeated queries.
